title: Topology Optimization Solver — Overview and definition
t: Topology Optimization Solver — Overview and definition
description: Distributes material in a design space to maximize stiffness at minimum weight.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Distributes material in a design space to maximize stiffness at minimum weight. A topology optimization solver iteratively removes low-stress material using SIMP, level-set, or BESO methods under volume, stress, and manufacturing constraints. Real implementations include TopOpt (DTU), Tosca, and the topology modules in nTop and Fusion. It enforces minimum feature size, symmetry, and draw-direction constraints so results are manufacturable.
capabilities: Density-based (SIMP) and level-set optimization
Compliance, stress, frequency, and thermal objectives
Manufacturing constraints: overhang, min size, symmetry, extrusion
Multi-load-case and multi-physics optimization
Smooth export of optimized geometry to CAD
